verdicts.reason: Fragments show file allocation/open (alloc_file, dentry_open) and dentry/inode refcount release (dput, iput), but omit dentry/inode creation, predicates, and shrink handling.
Shown fragments and cited symbols cover wait_for_root deadline polling, ramdisk type identification/loading, and initrd/tmpfs setup.
Fragments and citations cover sysctl_lock guarding unregistering, tty_mutex spanning seq walks, and proc maps locking/page table range serialization.
Citations show dentry_stat_t and slab init functions (alloc_vfsmnt, inode_init_once) which omit mount root/super and inode number, mode, state, and locks.

overall: Findings 2 and 3 are well-supported by their citations and fragments. Findings 1 and 4 overstate coverage relative to the specific functions and structs cited.
